facts.heading: Decision to divorce after 15 years
facts.content: Jana and Radka decided to divorce after 15 years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, Radka and I have decided to divorce.

facts.heading: Divorce decision in September
facts.content: Radka told Jana in September that the marriage was no longer possible.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it's not possible anymore.

facts.heading: Children's ages
facts.content: Jana has two children, Aniška who is 12 and Matěj who is 8.
facts.evidence: I have two kids. Aniška is 12 and Matěj is 8 years old.

facts.heading: Delaying telling children
facts.content: Jana and Radka are postponing telling the children about the divorce.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to say it together, but we keep postponing it.

facts.heading: Aniška's inquiry about arguing
facts.content: Last week, Aniška asked Jana if she and her dad were arguing.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were arguing with dad.

facts.heading: Jana's feeling after lying
facts.content: Jana felt terrible after lying to Aniška.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of ruining Aniška's life
facts.content: Jana feared that she would ruin Aniška's life.
facts.evidence: That I would ruin her life, that I would take her home.

facts.heading: Jana's job as teacher
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Grades Jana teaches
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th graders.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th graders.

facts.heading: Temporary living arrangements
facts.content: The apartment is in the pharmacy, and Radka is going to his brother's place for now.
facts.evidence: The apartment is in the pharmacy, Radek is going to his brother, at least so far.

facts.heading: Children staying with Jana
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Child in lap while studying
facts.content: Jana goes to class with a little boy in her lap.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a little boy in my lap.

facts.heading: Feels life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels that everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Teacher knows about situation
facts.content: Only the teacher knows about Jana's situation at school.
facts.evidence: Only the teacher.

facts.heading: Told teacher about crying
facts.content: Jana told the teacher about crying at the dance.
facts.evidence: I told her that because I once cried at the dance.

facts.heading: Teacher gave free hour
facts.content: The teacher gave Jana a free hour.
facts.evidence: She gave me a free hour.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at work
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at work.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work.

facts.heading: Sleeps badly every night
facts.content: Jana sleeps badly every night.
facts.evidence: Badly.

facts.heading: Wakes at 3 a.m. thinking
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 a.m. and thinks about what's next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3 a.m. and think about what's next.

facts.heading: Belief about no mortgage/husband
facts.content: Jana believes she has no mortgage, no husband, and nothing.
facts.evidence: I have no mortgage, no husband, nothing.

facts.heading: Counts money for children
facts.content: Jana counts the money and imagines how she will tell her children.
facts.evidence: I count the money and imagine how I will tell my children.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 and gets up at 7:30.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 and get up at 7.30.

facts.heading: Losing weight
facts.content: Jana has lost 4 kilos.
facts.evidence: I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Talks to sister in Olomouc
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening.

facts.heading: Talks to friend Eva from work
facts.content: Jana has a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: And my friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Fear of being bad example
facts.content: Jana is afraid that a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't keep a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's influence on marriage view
facts.content: Jana believes her mother influenced her view that marriage is a thing.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mum. She always said that marriage is a thing and that it's what it is.

facts.heading: Mother's silence upon introduction
facts.content: Jana's mother kept silent when Jana introduced her.
facts.evidence: She kept silent.

facts.heading: Jana's feelings about relationship
facts.content: Jana feels sad and states she needs forgiveness.
facts.evidence: Sad. I need you to forgive me.

facts.heading: Jana's desire to not be alone
facts.content: Jana states that it hurts and she doesn't want to be alone.
facts.evidence: That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone, but that it doesn't work with us.

facts.heading: Tried German tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana has tried German tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: German tea and that's all.

facts.heading: Refusal of sleeping powder
facts.content: Jana does not want the powder the doctor offered her.
facts.evidence: Doctor offered me some powder, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of dependency on medication
facts.content: Jana is afraid of being dependent on medication for sleep.
facts.evidence: I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Will write down waking thoughts
facts.content: Jana will try to sit next to the bed and write down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: I could. At least I'll get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Fear regarding children
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she will panic and cry around children.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry. That I won't be able to stay calm.

facts.heading: Feeling of not being alone
facts.content: Jana feels that she is not alone.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone

facts.heading: Not needing to act immediately
facts.content: Jana feels she does not have to do something right away.
facts.evidence: and I don't have to do it right away.
